description: This file defines classes and structures for managing front panel indicators, including color, blinking, brightness, and state control, within a device settings namespace. It includes class declarations for FrontPanelIndicator, its nested classes Color and Blink, and related methods and constants.

classes.name: FrontPanelIndicator
classes.description: Manages front panel indicator properties such as color, blink sequence, brightness, and state.

classes.name: FrontPanelIndicator::Color
classes.description: Represents predefined colors for the front panel indicator, extending DSConstant.

classes.name: FrontPanelIndicator::Blink
classes.description: Handles blink sequence parameters including interval and iteration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of FrontPanelIndicator by id or name.

methods.name: Color
methods.description: Constructor for Color class, representing a color option.

methods.name: Blink
methods.description: Constructor for Blink class, setting interval and iteration.

methods.name: getBrightnessLevels
methods.description: Retrieves brightness levels, min, and max.

methods.name: getMaxCycleRate
methods.description: Returns maximum cycle rate for scrolling.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the current color RGB value.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the indicator color by Color object or RGB value.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Enables or disables the front panel indicator.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns whether the indicator is enabled.
